list.name: myelin-associated (short T1)
list.source: Lab14: 106-225 ms, WM fraction 8.3 % at 3 T

list.name: intra/extracellular (long T1)
list.source: Lab14 main peak; St05/Wri08 bulk T1

pools: myelin water (between bilayers, ~15 % of WM water)
CSF partial volume at voxel scale
theory.exchange: Myelin water exchanges with intra/extra-axonal water on ~100-300 ms (intermediate on the T2 scale, fast on the T1 scale -> multi-component T1 is exchange-attenuated); intra- and extra-axonal water exchange slowly (~0.5-2 s) but have nearly equal T2 and coalesce; glial water is unresolved.
theory.rationale: Seven physical pools reduce to three apparent T2 components (myelin, IE, CSF) because IE-scale pools share T2 within the exchange-averaged tolerance; at clinical SNR two are resolvable, and the third (CSF) is unpinned by a 320 ms window. On the T1 axis exchange leaves only a weak short component (8 % at 3 T, rising with field).

list.name: intra/extracellular water
list.source: Whi97 gmT2 70-86 ms (GM at the upper end); St05 95

theory.exchange: Intra/extracellular water coalesce; myelin water is sparse; blood is a few percent at longer T2 (oxygenation dependent).
theory.rationale: The minor components (myelin ~4 %, blood ~5 %, CSF ~3 %) are each below the clinical detectability floor; GM is effectively mono-exponential to a CPMG train at SNR 100 and is the hard case for any short-T2 fraction.

ADC.source: MRM-web (2.0-3.0); free water at 37 C is 3.0

theory.rationale: K = 1 reference and the partial-volume contaminant of every brain entry; its T2 exceeds any clinical echo train, so it appears as a near-constant offset — the charter §3.2 sigma / long-T degeneracy in physical form.

water_content.source: as brain WM; cord-specific value not opened

3T.source: Smith & van Zijl ISMRM 2007: lateral 752+/-89, dorsal 745+/-61; St05 rat 993+/-47

list.name: myelin water
list.source: MacM07: whole-cord MWF 0.226, myelin T2 ~20 ms (window < 40 ms) at 3 T

list.name: intra/extracellular water
list.source: Smith & van Zijl 2007 bulk 65-66 ms; St05

theory.rationale: Same pool structure as brain WM with a larger myelin fraction (0.2-0.3), which is why the MWF is the easy myelin case, and a larger CSF contaminant, which is why the long component matters more.

1.5T.source: Han03 in vivo 35.3+/-3.9; St05 mouse 44+/-6; Saab99 imaging T2 31 ms

ADC.source: Maz21/Schlaffke: AD 1.9-2.6, RD 1.35-1.6 (unit flag in source); MRM-web 1.0-1.5

list.name: macromolecule-associated water
list.note: invisible to a 10 ms first echo

list.name: tensor: axial diffusivity
list.source: Maz21 PGSE TA/soleus AD 2.32/2.64; Schlaffke AD 1.89/2.14

theory.exchange: Intracellular sub-pools exchange on ms-tens of ms and are only separable at very high SNR (Saab99's 1000-echo, SNR 3500 data); intra/extracellular exchange ~ 100s of ms is slow enough to leave two visible components.
theory.rationale: Saab et al. needed SNR ~3500 and 1.2 ms echoes to see four components; a clinical 32 x 10 ms train sees the ~30 ms intracellular pool and, at best, the ~120 ms extracellular one (the oedema marker).

pd_relative_csf.source: collagen/PG matrix reduces mobile PD; not opened

1.5T.source: St05 (bovine 1024+/-70 at 0 deg); Han03 in vivo 1060+/-155

ADC.source: Raya 2012: healthy-vs-OA threshold ADC 1.2 (7 T); MRM-web n/a

list.name: collagen-bound water
list.note: needs UTE; invisible to CPMG at 10 ms

T2.note: ex vivo bovine nasal cartilage at 9.4 T (Rei09); in vivo human articular cartilage at 3 T has shorter bulk T2 (~35-45 ms) and a magic-angle dependence; Bou15 treats it as biexponential T2* at 3/7 T

pools: synovial fluid partial volume at the surface
theory.exchange: Bound and PG-associated water exchange with bulk on sub-ms to ms scales; the residual three-component structure (Rei09) survives because exchange is not complete. Orientation (magic angle) modulates T2 within the bulk pool, i.e. a distribution, not a discrete component.
theory.rationale: At clinical TE_1 = 6-10 ms the 2 ms pool is gone; what remains is a ~25 ms / ~90 ms pair with ratio ~4 and a 15 % minor fraction — resolvable at high SNR in thick cartilage, marginal in vivo where SNR and thickness are both smaller.

pd_relative_csf.source: most water is collagen-bound with sub-ms T2 (invisible at conventional TE)

3T.source: UTE-T1 of tendon ~ 600-800 ms; not opened
Qiao17: mono-exponential UTE T2* 11.1+/-0.3 ms (T2*, not CPMG T2)

list.name: short T2* (collagen-bound)
list.source: Du12: short-T2* fraction up to 80.9 % (ligament); short T2* 0.3-2.9 ms across tissues

theory.exchange: Bound/free exchange is fast relative to T1 but slow relative to the sub-ms/ms T2 split; magic-angle orientation dependence dominates the free pool's T2.
theory.rationale: A two-component UTE T2* case with ratio ~10 and a dominant short pool: the mirror image of the myelin problem (major short component), estimable when TE_1 < 0.5 ms.

water_content.source: Hor10: bound + pore water ~ 31-34 mol 1H/L; bulk water ~ 15-20 % by volume

3T.source: AR20 quoting prior work: free (pore) water T1 306 ms; bound water T1 ~ 100-150 ms

1.5T.source: AR20: bound-water T2* 0.45 ms (quoted), free-water T2* 2.81+/-0.31 ms (T2*, not CPMG T2)

list.name: pore water (and lipid)
list.source: Hor10: 1-1000 ms long-lived, 23.0+/-6.5 % (~60 % pore water / 40 % lipid); AR20 free T2* 2.8 ms at 1.5 T

T2.note: fractions renormalised over the two water pools visible to UTE; Hor10 also sees a 57 us pool (16 %) and a collagen 12 us pool (34 % of FID) that only solid-state methods reach

pools: pore water in Haversian/lacunar-canalicular space (1-1000 ms, itself distributed by pore size)
theory.exchange: Pore and bound water do not exchange on the T2 scale; pore water T2 is a size distribution, not one value.
theory.rationale: Well-separated (ratio > 10) but both pools are sub-10 ms and need UTE/ZTE; the continuous pore-size distribution makes the pore component a spectrum, the charter's continuum form in miniature.

water_content.source: fat fraction ~ 30-40 % in lumbar marrow of young adults (LeS16 33 %); water content of the non-fat part ~ 0.7

list.name: haematopoietic/water
list.source: LeS16 water fraction 67 %; T2 of marrow water ~ 40-60 ms (T2* 13.7)

list.name: fat (methylene)
list.source: LeS16 FF 33+/-8 %; fat T2 at 1.5 T 100-165 (Han03 165 for yellow marrow; dB04 68 at 3 T)

T2.note: fat and water are chemically shifted; Dixon separates them far better than T2 — this entry is a T2-only stress test

pools: adipocyte lipid (multiple resonances: methylene, methyl, olefinic)
theory.exchange: Fat and water do not exchange; the fat pool is itself multi-resonance (chemical shift, not relaxation).
theory.rationale: A ratio ~2 two-component case at the resolvability floor (delta ~ 2.7 at SNR 100): T2 alone should fail and chemical shift should be used — a deliberate 'wrong tool' row for the harness.

theory.exchange: Intra/extracellular exchange is fast enough at clinical TE that myocardium fits as mono-exponential; the vascular pool (~10 %, T2 ~ 100-250 ms depending on oxygenation) is the candidate second component that oedema/haemorrhage/iron perturb.
theory.rationale: K = 1 null case at clinical echo counts (8 x 12 ms): any method reporting two components here is fitting noise unless SNR and echo count are raised substantially.

1.5T.source: St05 (oxygenated in vitro 290+/-30); venous 50-200 depending on Y (Wikipedia tertiary)

ADC.source: free-water-like plus flow; Funck 2018 not opened

list.name: blood water (plasma + RBC, fast exchange)
list.source: St05 290 in vitro; in vivo arterial ~ 200-250 (RECALLED)

theory.exchange: Plasma-RBC water exchange ~ 10 ms is fast relative to the T2 difference: one apparent component whose T2 depends on oxygenation and echo spacing (Luz-Meiboom), i.e. a CPMG-spacing-dependent 'T2' — a model-misspecification case rather than a K > 1 case.
theory.rationale: K = 1 physically but with echo-spacing dependence; the partial-volume contaminant for kidney, spleen, liver and myocardium entries.

water_content.source: liver ~ 70-72 % water (Woodard & White not opened); RK PD 90

list.name: hepatocellular water
list.source: bulk T2 (St05/dB04); fraction = 1 - IVIM perfusion fraction (Luc08 f 0.27; Li17 0.22)

list.name: sinusoidal blood / bile
list.source: vascular fraction from IVIM f (0.22-0.27); T2 of partially deoxygenated blood 100-200 ms

T2.note: no in vivo multi-component liver T2 study reached (Ber83 ex vivo biexponential, no values); the split is a working configuration from IVIM and bulk T2

pools: sinusoidal blood (large: ~ 25 % of volume, hence IVIM f 0.2-0.3)
theory.exchange: Hepatocyte-sinusoid water exchange across fenestrated endothelium is fast (tens of ms), so the blood pool is partially averaged into the parenchymal T2; steatosis adds a chemically shifted fat pool; iron collapses T2 (T2* especially).
theory.rationale: The large vascular fraction is the physical reason liver ADC is IVIM-biexponential; on the T2 axis the same pool is partially exchange-averaged and only a long tail survives — a good test of whether T2 and diffusion compartment fractions agree (they need not).

ADC.source: EJR20 0.85 (SD anomalous); Yam99 IVIM D 0.80; MRM-web n/a

list.name: sinusoidal / venous blood
list.source: spleen is ~ 30-40 % blood by volume; venous T2 100-150 ms at 1.5 T

T2.note: no multi-component spleen relaxometry reached in the literature search; working configuration

theory.exchange: Open circulation: cell water and blood exchange freely; splenic T2 is strongly oxygenation- and blood-volume-dependent (splenic contraction). Likely close to mono-exponential with a long blood tail.
theory.rationale: Ratio ~2 between the working components: at the resolvability floor, so the T2 axis will report K = 1; the IVIM axis is where the blood pool shows.

1.5T.source: St05 (rat whole kidney 690+/-30); in vivo human cortex ~ 950 (RECALLED)
St05 rat whole kidney 55+/-3; human cortex at 1.5 T ~ 80-90 (RECALLED)

ADC.source: vBa17 cortex D 2.04+/-0.08 (bi-exp); Fil15 D 1.7, ADC MRM-web 1.5-2.5

list.name: tubular lumen fluid + glomerular capillary blood
list.source: IVIM f 0.10-0.21 (vBa17, Fil15) plus tubular fluid; Tas24 uses the long-T2 amplitude as a tubule-volume surrogate

T2.functional: tubular/vascular long-T2 fraction (1 - mass below 120 ms)
T2.note: in vivo human multi-component renal T2 not reached; Tas24 (rat, 9.4 T) supports a biexponential structure; working configuration

pools: glomerular and peritubular capillary blood (high renal blood flow; f ~ 0.1-0.2)
theory.exchange: Aquaporin-rich epithelium makes lumen-cell water exchange fast (ms), so tubular fluid is largely averaged into the parenchymal T2; blood and free fluid contribute a long tail; directional tubular flow gives the medulla its diffusion anisotropy.
theory.rationale: Physiologically the most compartmentalised abdominal organ, yet fast water exchange hides it on T2; the documented multi-exponential signal is in diffusion (IVIM, with the fluid/flow component) and in rat T2 at 9.4 T. A strong test case for 'exchange-coupled' ground truth (charter §6.1).

water_content.source: medulla slightly wetter than cortex; not opened

1.5T.source: human medulla at 1.5 T ~ 1200-1400; not opened

list.name: luminal fluid (loops of Henle, collecting ducts) + vasa recta blood
list.source: vBa17 medullary f 15.8 %; larger luminal fraction than cortex

T2.functional: luminal/vascular long-T2 fraction (1 - mass below 120 ms)

list.name: pseudo-diffusion D*
list.source: medullary D* not on an opened page; cortex 15.6 (Fil15)

pools: luminal fluid in radially oriented tubules (directional flow)
theory.exchange: As cortex, with a larger luminal fraction and radial orientation: diffusion is anisotropic, T2 slightly longer, T1 longer (higher water content, hypertonicity).
theory.rationale: Companion row to the cortex; the medulla/cortex difference is the clinically used contrast (corticomedullary differentiation), so the dictionary must carry both.

water_content.source: ~ 70-75 % water; fat infiltration increases with age; not opened

T2.note: no multi-component pancreatic T2 study reached; working configuration

theory.exchange: Cell-capillary exchange fast; fat is a chemically shifted non-exchanging pool; perfusion dominates the IVIM signal.
theory.rationale: Perfusion-rich organ with a short bulk T2: the IVIM axis carries the compartment information; on T2 the organ is near mono-exponential unless fat infiltration is present.

water_content.source: glandular tissue with abundant luminal fluid; not opened

1.5T.source: PZ ~ 100-130 at 1.5 T (higher than whole gland); not opened

3T.source: dB04 whole gland 74+/-9 (PZ alone is longer, ~ 100-120 RECALLED)

list.name: epithelial / stromal water
list.source: Sab17 T2short (values not reachable this session)

list.name: luminal water
list.source: Sab17 T2long / LWF; LWF correlates with luminal space (JMRI 46:861, rho 0.75) and falls with Gleason grade (rho -0.78)

T2.functional: luminal water fraction (1 - mass below 200 ms)
T2.note: the strongest clinically validated two-component T2 case; component numbers still RECALLED pending the full text

pools: glandular lumen fluid (secretions; large in normal PZ)
theory.exchange: Lumen-epithelium exchange is slow relative to the large T2 difference (ratio ~ 8), so two components persist; stroma and epithelium share T2 and coalesce. Cancer replaces lumen with cells -> LWF falls.
theory.rationale: Well-separated, both fractions large: the easy case, estimable to ~5 % on the LWF with a 64-echo train — the positive control for every estimator.

list.name: fat (methylene)
list.source: RP06 breast fat T2 53 (short, spin-echo w/ J-coupling); Han03 subcutaneous fat 165 (1.5 T); dB04 68 (3 T) — CPMG fat T2 is sequence-dependent

T2.note: fat T2 under CPMG depends on echo spacing (J-coupling); Dixon is the right tool — a deliberate 'wrong tool' row like marrow

theory.exchange: Water pools coalesce; fat is non-exchanging and chemically shifted; the apparent two-component T2 is a water/fat mixture, not two water pools.
theory.rationale: Ratio ~2 with sequence-dependent fat T2: at the resolvability floor and misspecified for a pure-exponential kernel; belongs in the harness as a failure-mode row.
